messages:
Devon: Quick follow-up from the KV-eviction postmortem — we promised a set of eval/test additions to reduce recurrence. Sketching owners, scope, and timelines here.
Rachit: thanks. can you paste links to the postmortem and the incident ticket?
Devon: Postmortem: https://redwood/postmortems/kv-eviction-2026  Incident: #4582
Esther: I'll own the regression prompt-set curation. plan to produce curated prompt families + expected QA tags. ETA end of next sprint (2026-02-09).
Luca: I'll take the load-test harness improvements: add long-tail sequence lengths, more concurrent streams, and inject KV miss patterns. target 2026-02-01.
SRE-Bot: Deploy alert: dedicated-pool autoscale tweak deployed at 1998503300.
Sophie: For chaos drills, propose a low-risk drill mid-Feb: "kv-evict-drill-v1". I'll scope blast radius, safety gates, and rollback criteria.
Rachit: ACTION: Rachit -> automate a daily prefix-cache regression smoke (ticket #4620). Smoke should run against staging and report token-level latency deltas. ETA 2026-01-18.
Devon: ACTION: Devon -> add prompt sets to the evals repo under evals/kv-evictions/promptsets. Use jsonl: {"prompt":..., "expected_tags":[...]}. Also include a short README with acceptance criteria.
Esther: question: are we keeping golden outputs or just tags? I recommend storing tags + representative golden snippets (no sensitive user data).
Luca: on load tests — we need KV hit/miss ratio instrumentation in the perf harness and a step that replays realistic traffic distributions. I'll open PR to perf-tests branch.
Sophie: Runbook note: drill runbook will include pre-checks, success/failure criteria, and immediate revert plan. I'll share draft by 2026-01-25.
Rachit: can we add a 5% canary route to the quantized model variant to catch latency regressions early?
Devon: yes — add a new canary workflow in rollout-playbook that measures p50/p95 latency on the curated prompt set and fails rollout if degradation > 15%.
Rachit: ACTION: Rachit -> create ticket #4631 to implement canary automation and dashboards. Target 2026-02-05 for initial canary test.
Esther: timeline recap in one line: prompt sets (2026-02-09), daily smoke (2026-01-18), load harness (2026-02-01), chaos runbook (2026-01-25), canary automation (2026-02-05).
Devon: I'll own cross-team coordination and weekly status pings. please drop blockers in this thread or tag me directly.
Luca: note — I'll need access to the private perf cluster (perf-cluster-2). @Sophie can you grant by EOD?
SRE-Bot: Access request created: AR-772 for Luca. Approver: Sophie.
Sophie: I'll review and approve AR-772 today.
Devon: I'll add these tickets and owners to the PM board and update the postmortem doc with links. We'll run a micro-sync in Thu standup to confirm no overlaps.
Esther: added a sample schema for promptset jsonl in a gist: https://redwood/gists/promptset-schema
Luca: PR incoming for harness instrumentation. tagging @Devon for review.
Sophie: :thumbsup: on the plan.
Devon: Thanks everyone — short wins: daily smoke first, then runbook, then load tests, then full chaos drill. Keep updates coming in-thread.
Esther: 👍
Luca: 👍
Sophie: ✅
